game.name: RE:RUN
game.rules:
- You need to complete all levels from 0 to 10. Do not skip any of them.

- Timing starts at level0 when spawning and ends at the last level at the menu screen.  
- The Pause glitch isn't allowed or any kind of modification of the in-game time.

- Binding a key to mouse isn't allowed. Main concern is spamming crouch with mouse, as that will just make the whole game a game of who can click the fastest with weird clicking tech.

- You will need to display the fps. (in-game fps not external fps displays!)
Press "Tab" while in game and type "fps 1" into the console. this will display the fps This will ensure that you don't have an uncapped fps. You are allowed to have up to 200fps (the normal cap if you don't change anything.)
(having uncapped fps can make the animations really fast and give you an unfair advantage, it also makes some tricks easier to execute)

- Only modifications allowed is the "PreEnabled FPS and SPEED" and the "updated version " in https://www.speedrun.com/rerun/resources

- You need to at least have the in-game sounds on. Music would also be great but isn't 100% mandatory.

- You can't pause while doing a speedrun 
(This only counts for IL speedruns or rather speedruns that are timed with IGT which are only IL speedruns)

- Using any kind of modification of the game isn't allowed.
Only the "PreEnabled FPS and SPEED " mod by KazUpTV https://www.speedrun.com/rerun/resources

i was listening to music which is why there isn't game sound
